label: context.reference
text:
Use the Box Application through world_mcp_box. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Box files, folders, search, metadata, and collaboration capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_box.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_box, label mcp.operation.request, operation box.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use box.read_resource, box.get_prompt and box.complete with catalog identifiers; use box.status or box.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
